title: Google Map Theme
content:
## Google Map Theme


Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000010586

The Google Map Theme Setting allows the admin to select a theme for the directory maps. To select this theme, navigate to: Settings Design Settings General Tab Main Design Google Map Theme Click on the drop down on the setting named "Google Map Theme", select the preferred theme: Maps Themes The available options are: Classic Apple View Modern Colors View Midnight Colors View Black and White Colors View Classic View This option will select the Classic View, which is a timeless rendition with familiar map features and a traditional color scheme. Apple View This option will select the Apple View, which emulates the aesthetics of Apple Maps, offering a clean and familiar design. Modern Colors View This option selects the Modern Colors View, which is vibrant and contemporary, presenting map data with fresh and lively hues. Midnight Colors View This option selects the Midnight Colors View, which evokes a sense of nightfall with deep, subdued tones for a sophisticated look. Black & White Colors View This option selects the Black and White Colors View, which is a minimalist approach, highlighting map details in stark monochrome contrast.
